g.text: Pick the key that makes your most important query single-shard. Fix balance by splitting.
1. Name your highest-QPS query and your highest-correctness query.
2. Pick the key that makes THOSE single-shard.
3. Only then check write balance — and fix it by splitting, not by changing the key.
Bounded (3 of 100,000, decided by geometry) is healthy.
Unbounded (all N) means p99 = slowest of N, and cost grows as you scale.
